The name Sharvikaa is associated with the Goddess Parvati, who is considered the feminine aspect of Lord Shiva. The name is considered to be a divine and powerful one, often bestowed upon children as a blessing from the Goddess.

The name is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and happiness to the person bearing it. It is also believed that the name Sharvikaa bestows the blessings of Lord Shiva upon the individual, granting them strength, courage, and inner peace.
